decorators.name: penv
decorators.doc: Links this schema to a cloud project. `@penv=<provider>:org/project` reads it from another provider ([docs/PROVIDERS.md](https://github.com/penvhq/penvhq/blob/main/docs/PROVIDERS.md)). Without it, penv runs in local mode from the `.env` files beside the schema.

decorators.name: schema
decorators.doc: The grammar version this schema is written for. `.penv/config.toml` holds it now; a value here is still read.

decorators.name: defaultSensitive
decorators.doc: Whether a key is sensitive when it says nothing itself. A bundler-prefixed key (`NEXT_PUBLIC_`, `VITE_`, ...) is never sensitive by default.

decorators.name: defaultRequired
decorators.doc: `true`: a key with no default needs a value. `false`: no key does unless marked. `infer`: a key with a value in the schema is required.

decorators.name: currentEnv
decorators.doc: The key that names the environment when neither `--env` nor `PENV_ENV` is set.

decorators.name: import
decorators.doc: Reads the keys of another schema. Name keys after the path to take only those.

decorators.name: assert
decorators.doc: `penv check` and `penv run` fail with the message when the expression is false.

decorators.name: type
decorators.doc: Validated before the command starts. Constraints go in brackets: `string(startsWith=sk_)`, `number(min=1, max=10)`, `enum(a, b)`.

decorators.name: required
decorators.doc: The key needs a value. `@required=forEnv(production)` needs one only in the environments named.

decorators.name: optional
decorators.doc: The key may be empty. `@optional=forEnv(development)` allows that only in the environments named.

decorators.name: sensitive
decorators.doc: Masked in the output of every `penv run`. `@sensitive=false` marks a value that may be shown. A bundler-prefixed key cannot be sensitive.

decorators.name: example
decorators.doc: A sample value for people reading the schema. Never used as the value.

decorators.name: docs
decorators.doc: Where this key is documented.

decorators.name: deprecated
decorators.doc: Marks the key as on its way out.

decorators.name: dynamic
decorators.doc: The spec's marker for a value read at runtime. penv keeps it and does not act on it.

decorators.name: static
decorators.doc: The spec's marker for a value fixed at build time. penv keeps it and does not act on it.

decorators.name: hosts
decorators.doc: Seals the value. An agent's process holds a placeholder shaped by `@type`, and `penv run` puts the real value in only on the way to these hosts. At most 32.

decorators.name: rotate
decorators.doc: `penv check` reminds you to rotate the value once it is older than this. Units, largest first: `y`, `m` (months), `w`, `d`, `h`, `min`, `s`, as in `1y6m`, `90d`, `12h`, `30min`.

decorators.name: generateTypes
decorators.doc: varlock's. penv reads past it; `penv gen` writes typed files.

decorators.name: plugin
decorators.doc: varlock's. penv loads no plugins; providers are compiled in.

decorators.name: redactLogs
decorators.doc: varlock's. penv reads past it; every `penv run` masks sensitive values.

decorators.name: preventLeaks
decorators.doc: varlock's. penv reads past it.

decorators.name: envFlag
decorators.doc: varlock's older name for `@currentEnv`. penv reads past it.

decorators.name: setValuesBulk
decorators.doc: varlock's. penv reads past it.

decorators.name: disable
decorators.doc: varlock's. penv reads past it.

functions.name: ref
functions.doc: Another key's value. `${KEY}` inside text does the same.

functions.name: concat
functions.doc: Joins its arguments into one string.

functions.name: fallback
functions.doc: The first argument that is not empty.

functions.name: if
functions.doc: `then` when the condition is true, otherwise `else` or empty. `false`, `0` and empty are false.

functions.name: eq
functions.doc: `true` when both are the same text.

functions.name: not
functions.doc: `true` when the argument is false, `0` or empty.

functions.name: forEnv
functions.doc: `true` when the current environment is one of those named.

functions.name: penv
functions.doc: A value read from the provider. `env/KEY` uses the project `@penv=` names; `penv()` reads this key from the current environment.

functions.name: match
functions.doc: The value of the case whose label equals the subject; `_` is the case taken when none does.

functions.name: startsWith
functions.doc: `true` when the value starts with the prefix.

functions.name: endsWith
functions.doc: `true` when the value ends with the suffix.

functions.name: random
functions.doc: N random characters, generated once by `penv run` and kept in `.env.local`.

filters.name: urlencode
filters.doc: Percent-encodes the value for a URL.

types.name: enum
types.doc: One of the members listed: `enum(development, staging, production)`.
